text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp with Biwa Hayahide commences.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin are here too, and they run into us right as we're unloading our luggage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All three of them are fired up about the Kikuka Sho, so it's time to let the summer of friendly rivalry begin!
